question.text: $\mathrm{MgSO}_4$ on reaction with $\mathrm{NH}_4 \mathrm{OH}$ and $\mathrm{Na}_2 \mathrm{HPO}_4$ forms a white crystalline precipitate. What is its formula?

solution.text: $\mathrm{MgSO}_4$ on reaction with $\mathrm{Na}_2 \mathrm{HPO}_4$ (disodium hydrogen phosphate) in presence of $\mathrm{NH}_4 \mathrm{OH}$ to give white precipitate of magnesium ammonium phosphate $\left(\mathrm{Mg}\left(\mathrm{NH}_4\right) \mathrm{PO}_4\right)$.
